glossary.definition: (B) As used in this section, "personal consumer" means an individual who is at least twenty-one years of age, does not hold a permit issued under chapter 4303. of the Revised Code, and intends to use a purchased alcoholic beverage for personal consumption only and not for resale or other commercial purposes.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.243 - Giving things of value in connection with purchase of alcoholic beverage.
